item.title: Massive SCOTUS verdict on ‘Trump Tariffs’: IEEPA does not authorise US President to impose tariffs
item.description: After becoming US President for the 2nd time, President Donald Trump imposed tariffs by invoking his authority under International Emergency Economic Powers Act to deal with influx of illegal drugs from Canada, Mexico and large and persistent trade deficits. The post Massive SCOTUS verdict on ‘Trump Tariffs’: IEEPA does not authorise US President to impose tariffs appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: NHRC issues notice over reported assault on journalist covering Delhi University protest
item.description: The NHRC has issued a notice to the Delhi Police Commissioner, calling for a detailed report on the matter within two weeks. The post NHRC issues notice over reported assault on journalist covering Delhi University protest appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Negative DNA report does not exonerate an accused in rape cases: Tripura High Court
item.description: “The purpose of DNA test in rape case is to facilitate the prosecution to prove its case against the accused and merely because the DNA test has a negative report”. The post Negative DNA report does not exonerate an accused in rape cases: Tripura High Court appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Patentee not liable for agent’s negligence; Restoration of expired patent allowed: Orissa High Court
item.description: “The non-payment of renewal fee within the time was due to the fault of the authorised agent, and the date of expiry of the patent on 22-09-2021 was within the Covid-19 pandemic period.” The post Patentee not liable for agent’s negligence; Restoration of expired patent allowed: Orissa High Court appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: New Rule Requires E-commerce Platforms to Clearly Display Country of Origin for Imported Products
item.description: Govt notified the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules introducing mandatory country-of-origin filters for imported products sold via e-commerce to improve consumer awareness. The post New Rule Requires E-commerce Platforms to Clearly Display Country of Origin for Imported Products appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Madhya Pradesh High Court dismisses PIL challenging stoppage of fresh registrations in Ladli Behna Yojana
item.description: The Court held that decisions relating to eligibility criteria, age limits, and closure of registrations fall within the executive policy domain of the State and are not amenable to judicial review in the absence of arbitrariness, statutory violation, or unconstitutionality. The post Madhya Pradesh High Court dismisses PIL challenging stoppage of fresh registrations in Ladli Behna Yojana appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Free consent can’t be retrospectively withdrawn to criminalise a failed consensual relationship: Delhi High Court
item.description: “Criminal law is meant to protect genuine victims of crime, not to rewrite the history of a relationship that was voluntarily entered into, publicly acknowledged, and sustained over several years.” The post Free consent can’t be retrospectively withdrawn to criminalise a failed consensual relationship: Delhi High Court appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Jharkhand HC stays investigation in minor road accident, safeguards advocate from coercive action
item.description: “The federal structure of our Constitution of India cannot be allowed to be destroyed and it is a duty of the High Court that once such type of matter is brought to the knowledge of the Court, the High Court is required to rise to the occasion.” The post Jharkhand HC stays investigation in minor road accident, safeguards advocate from coercive action appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Key Highlights of the Aircraft (Carriage of Dangerous Goods) Rules 2026
item.description: These rules govern the transport of dangerous goods by air for all aircraft registered in India, aircraft operating in or over India, air transport operators, shippers, and designated postal operators. The post Key Highlights of the Aircraft (Carriage of Dangerous Goods) Rules 2026 appeared first on SCC Times.

item.description: Explore the latest Supreme Court cases in 2026 SCC Vol. 1 Part 5 covering Article 19 free speech, stray dogs regulation, Customs electronic evidence, Power Purchase Agreements and cheque dishonour litigation.
